title: Sleepy Meadows
description: My goal is to make the game still look like minecraft but give it a more warm and cosy vibe.
body: I wanted to make the game more warm and less harsh on the eyes due to me usually playing the game at later times during the day. The pack is not yet complete but I am happy with overall colour changes and minor texture tweaks that I have made. My goal is to make the game still look like minecraft but give it a more warm and cosy vibe.
